messages:
eric: Heads-up — after pulling the latest flash-variants SNAPSHOT from upstream I see a perf regression on our paged-attn path. p95 token latency up ~18% on long-context workloads (8k).

maria: ugh. which commit? link?

eric: upstream tag: flash-variants@2026-03-01-rc3 (sha: b7f9d2). failing on runs that use KV cache + fused attention. quick log: ```2026-03-15T14:02:09Z | model=redwood-7b | seq=8192 | p95=142ms (baseline 120ms) | kernel=flashfv_paged_fused_v2```

sanjay: did we change kernel selection heuristics recently? or is this purely upstream kernel perf?

eric: we didn't touch selection logic in canary. baseline kernels unchanged. profiling shows extra memcpy in fused path when KV cache hits >1.

ciara: could be the vec4 vendor drop I saw in the vendor-props PR last week — some vendors removed vec4 vectorized kernels and upstream added a scalar fallback that regresses on long sequences.

maria: @ciara do you have the PR?

ciara: https://github.com/vendorx/vec-kernels/commit/3f2a — vendor dropped vec4 impl; upstream flash-variants added a compatibility shim in fa_conv but it falls back to slower loops.

sanjay: That matches our flamegraph — hot path is memcpy + scalar attention loop. KV cache reuse increases memcpy frequency.

eric: repro script attached in gist (quick run): ```python3 tests/perf/repro_paged.py --model redwood-7b --seq 8192 --batch 1 --use-kv``` Repro steps deterministic on our infra.

maria: CI shows a flake in xformers integration too — xformers pr #452 reorders kernels for quantized paths. Might interact.

deploy-bot: build/eng-runtime-flashvariants-2026-03-15 #212 failed on integration-tests/paged-attn. See: https://ci.redwood/212

sanjay: we need triage: 1) confirm source (vendor vs xformers vs our selection); 2) add canary that forces older flash-variants; 3) add perf regression alert for paged+kv combos.

ciara: I can pin upstream to rc2 on our canary pool and run the bench matrix. Will run dedicated-12p and hosted-sim both.

eric: pls also record per-kernel counters (kernel_name, exec_us, memcpy_bytes) in trace span. Current traces only report total token time.

maria: on batching heuristics: if memcpy cost dominates for long seq, batching more small requests might amortize cost, but for single-request 8k it's still bad. We should test batching factor 1..8.

sanjay: action items:
- ciara: pin/rollback upstream on canary and post results (due EOD)
- eric: add kernel counters to runtime traces + repro scripts (due tomorrow)
- maria: add xformers compatibility check to nightly matrix + run fused-attn microbench (due 48h)
- infra: mark dedicated pool as canary for this roll (will coordinate)

ciara: started canary run now (job 9876). first pass will compare rc2 vs rc3 across seqs [512,2048,8192] and KV on/off.

deploy-bot: job 9876 queued on canary-dedicated-12p. ETA ~20m.

eric: quick note — fallback policy: if we detect memcpy spikes >50MB/s on paged path, runtime should select fallback kernel (flash-variants-v1 classic) for that request. I can add a heuristic gate.

maria: agree, but make gate conservative. We don't want oscillation during autoscale bursts. Maybe add cooldown 30s per worker.

sanjay: also add a metric to Console: paged_attn_kernel_fallback_count and avg_memcpy_us. Ops wants alert if fallback >5% traffic for 10m.

ciara: canary results (first batch): rc2 p95 118ms, rc3 p95 141ms on seq=8192 KV=on. rc3 shows +20% exec_us in flashfv_paged_fused kernel and memcpy_bytes x1.8.

eric: thanks — that strongly points to the vendor vec4 removal shim. I'll open a downstream patch to prefer classic kernel when memcpy ratio >0.4.

maria: can we also ask upstream to ship a vectorized fallback? open issue + link our flamegraphs. I'll draft.

ciara: opened GH issue: https://github.com/flash-variants/flash-variants/issues/1120 with profile svg and repro.

sanjay: timeline: rollback on hosted API tomorrow if no upstream fix in 48h. For dedicated customers we'll do auto-fallback.

eric: filed internal RFC for kernel selection heuristics change (link: https://rwd/eng/runtime/rfcs/kernel-selection-2026-03-15)

maria: nice work. keep thread updated — especially if upstream posts a patch.

ciara: will update when job 9876 completes (next msg).

eric: thx — tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:
